resources.string: Applies only to the chapter reading screen.
When you mark the last chapter planned for the day, the app offers that day's study. It's an analysis that brings together all the passages you read, different from each chapter's study.
When you finish the day's last chapter
A window covers the screen with the day's summary and the button to generate the study.
A strip at the bottom that doesn't interrupt your reading and goes away when dismissed.
You won't see the suggestion anymore when you finish the day
Enable the suggestion to choose how it appears
Saves your study suggestion setting to your account and applies it to all your devices
